prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: landscape school science textbook opener, 1536x1024. Use the attached reference ONLY for its warm hand-painted 2D gouache/watercolour children's-book style, natural anatomy and expressive faces; no photorealistic humans. Depict a Sikkim family: a girl and boy aged about 12 with their elderly grandfather at a safe distance observing grandmother stirring thukpa soup in a large metal pot on a properly vented enclosed wood stove. A stove pipe goes upwards; no open indoor campfire, children do not touch hot objects. Compact cutout vignette, entire people visible, winter woollen clothing, modest Himalayan home context suggested by a small wooden floor patch only. Genuine transparent RGBA background all around the irregular silhouettes; no rectangular backdrop, no frame, no lettering, no labels, no arrows. Wide balanced composition, detailed but calm, clear readable objects at textbook size.

Use case: scientific-educational. Painted 2D gouache/watercolour cutout on genuine transparent RGBA, landscape 1536x1024. Attached image is style only. Three clear separate still-life objects in a horizontal composition: folded woollen blanket with visibly soft fibres; a cutaway hollow clay building brick showing open internal cavities; a ceramic cup of tea with handle. These illustrate materials and trapped-air insulation. Realistic material structure, warm earth tones and muted blue fabric, clean soft painted edges, no people, no text, no arrows, no framing, no rectangular background. Each object large and identifiable, no overlap.

Use case: scientific-educational. Transparent RGBA schoolbook illustration, landscape 1536x1024, warm hand-painted 2D gouache/watercolour matching attached style reference without copying its scene. A traditional Himalayan bukhari: compact dark iron enclosed stove with securely shut front door, flat top holding one metal cooking pot, long chimney pipe extending upward and out of image composition, short stable legs on a small stone hearth patch. Three-quarter view. Show no smoke indoors, no fire outside stove, no people, no arrows, no words, no frame or rectangular backdrop. Clear structure with restrained warm highlights, isolated complete cutout with ample alpha around it.

Use case: scientific-educational. Landscape textbook conceptual scenery 1536x1024, genuine transparent RGBA beyond irregular vignette edges, warm painted 2D gouache/watercolour in attached style. A compact land-to-sea water-cycle landscape: left low sea with inlet, central green foothills with river flowing continuously into sea on left, right high mountains with snowy summit and stream connecting into river, a few leafy trees in foreground, two small clouds above hills and mountains, faint rain below one cloud and sun at far upper left. Preserve lots of clear sky/transparent gaps for separate live labels to be placed later. No diagram arrows, no text, no people, no black outlines, no flat cartoon geometries, no enclosing border or rectangular sky/background. Scientifically plausible terrain, no waterfalls disconnected from water bodies. Painting should be clear not busy.

Use case: scientific-educational. School science textbook painted 2D gouache/watercolour illustration in attached reference style, transparent RGBA landscape 1536x1024. Depict Ladakh winter water storage: one tall roughly conical ice stupa formed from many icicles and frozen layers, a slender pipe reaching near its top and spraying a fine arc of droplets onto the icy cone; rocky ground patch and a small shallow channel at the foot, distant barren mountain silhouettes very restrained. No religious ornaments, no temple, no people, no text, no arrows, no rectangular background, no border. Keep entire ice cone visible and clear, irregular cutout vignette, ample transparent margins.
